name: aagdb-graphic-pipeline
domain: Turn a customer's angel-name request into a personalised graphic and email it to them exactly once.
success_definition: The customer received one email containing their angel graphic, and the mail server confirmed the send.
out_of_scope: Graphics whose option has requires_photo = true: those are drawn by hand from a customer upload and the worker never claims them.
Shop orders (purchases table) — separate Stripe flow, not part of this pipeline.
Requests created before the worker's automation cutoff (WORKER_MIN_CREATED_AT).

entry.surface: POST /submit from the request form at /form

status_notes.validated: Graphic generated and stored in entry_photos. Nothing emailed yet.
status_notes.applied: Delivery intent recorded and the email handed to SMTP. Outcome not yet known.
status_notes.processed: Delivery confirmed. Kept as the final state name rather than 'completed' so the existing admin portal and queries are unchanged.
status_notes.escalated: Automation has stopped on purpose. A person must decide.

version.guard: Every worker transition is a compare-and-set on (id, status, version). A mismatch aborts the write.

concurrency.note: Row-level claims replace a debounce window: the poll loop is single-tick and a locked row is invisible to another worker. Duplicate sends are prevented by the unique delivery key rather than by timing.

checks: graphic_code present and not a requires_photo graphic
graphic bytes stored in entry_photos before the row is marked validated
validation.reuses_prior_output: A retry reuses the stored generated photo instead of calling xAI again.

apply.guard: graphic_deliveries.idempotency_key is UNIQUE and the row is written before the send.

outcomes.sent: SMTP accepted the message. Delivery key is closed forever; entry goes to processed with a version bump.
outcomes.not_sent: Proven never sent (bad auth, bad recipient, no connection). Retry is allowed.
outcomes.unknown: Timeout or dropped socket. The message may have arrived, so the entry is escalated and never retried automatically.

escalation.channel: email to FAILURE_ALERT_EMAIL plus the admin portal banner and bell
always_escalate: permanent failure (missing email, missing graphic, no placeholder artwork)
escalation.human_release: POST /admin/entries/:id/allow-resend, after checking the customer's inbox

routes.note: Costs money, so it is never repeated for an entry that already has stored output.

loop_policy.note: A processed entry is never re-claimed. New work arrives only as a new form submission, an admin release for resend, or a backoff requeue of a failure.

kill_switch.effect: No new work is claimed. Housekeeping sweeps keep running.
